name: qSemSeg (ONNX semantic segmentation)
description: Applies a pretrained semantic segmentation model (ONNX, e.g. FKAConv or SphereFormer) to the selected point cloud using ONNX Runtime (CPU, NVIDIA CUDA or DirectML - any DX12 GPU - with automatic CPU fallback). The predicted labels are added to the cloud as a new scalar field.
